FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Abrasives Sectional Committee-had been approved by the Production Engineering Division Council. Multi-point diamond dressing tools are used for dressing and truing of grinding wheels. These are capable of taking higher feed rates and reduce dressing time. Mounting of multi-point diamon_d impregnated dressing tools may be done either: i) By swivelling holders with morse taper shank MT 0 and MT 1 or parallel shanks; or ii) Rigidly brazed on morse taper shanks MT 0 and MT 1 or parallel shanks. considerable assistance While preparing this specification, supplied by the manufacturers and users of this product. has been derived from the details
